subject: ProofPoint POC: auxiliary sandbox endorsement for high-QPS proofpoint run
messages:
From: Riley Chen <riley@proofpoint.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ProofPoint POC - request for temporary top-up for overnight soak

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is keen to run a soak that simulates peak query traffic for our next validation window. We ran a quick estimate and will need an extra burst allowance to finish a 6-hour night soak (target window: Oct 5, 01:00–07:00 PT).

Quick details:
- Objective: validate 99th-pct latency under sustained 1k r/s (1,000 requests/sec) traffic pattern for our RAG pipeline
- Expected tokens: ~320k tokens over 6 hours (mix of 1k–2k token requests)
- Telemetry we will share: p95/p99 latencies, error rates, and resource profiles

Can Redwood provision a temporary credit uplift or sandbox headroom for the window? We can accept a time-limited promo code / ephemeral quota. If helpful I attached our short test plan (PDF).

Appreciate a quick thumbs up — we need to lock the window by Monday.

Riley
Riley Chen
Staff SRE, ProofPoint

Attachment: proofpoint_test_plan.pdf (3 pages)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Riley Chen <riley@proofpoint.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ProofPoint POC - request for temporary top-up for overnight soak

Hi Riley — thanks for the clear breakdown, this is helpful. Two quick clarifying questions before I loop in capacity ops:
1) Is the 1k r/s sustained (steady) or a stepped pattern (bursts + 0/quiet periods)?
2) Do you need token-level credits (hosted API tokens) or a sandbox concurrency bump on a dedicated endpoint?

If you confirm tokens-only (hosted), we can usually approve an ephemeral promo for token uplift scoped to the date/time and HubSpot deal. If you need a dedicated endpoint burst we will need a short runbook and an internal capacity sign-off.

I attached the test plan you referenced and will open an internal request concurrently.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Grace — quick answers below:
- Pattern: stepped ramp to 1k r/s over 20 minutes, then steady for 5 hours, then 30-minute tailoff. A couple of 30s microbursts at 1.2k r/s to simulate client variance.
- Tokens vs endpoint: tokens only is fine for this run, everything will go through the hosted API.

If you can issue an ephemeral uplift (time-boxed promo) that caps at 400k tokens for the window that should be enough headroom. Let me know if you need a narrower cap.

Riley

Recommended options (pick one):
A) Approve promo voucher for 400k tokens scoped to D-90213-PF, valid 2026-10-05 01:00–08:00 PT (include 1h buffer)

Could you confirm by EOD? If comfortable I can escalate to Jonas for final sign-off.

Thanks,
Grace
